The refused save sent again on every sync

must_not: The receipt cancelled

steps.action: Try to cancel the membership or move its end date (freeze / extra days)
must_not: The membership changed

user_sees: 'The front desk can date a payment at most 31 days back. Ask the owner to enter older payments.'
must_not: The payment saved

steps.action: Take back yesterday's session
must_not: Yesterday's session removed by the front desk

steps.action: Mark a session on a cancelled pack

must_not: The taker changed after saving
